input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: A full sweep of the document (searches for "liability", "consequential", "in no event", "damages", "indemnif" and a read of the General Provisions, Warranties and Confidentiality sections) shows no limitation of liability, no aggregate cap and no exclusion of consequential damages anywhere. The only occurrences of "liability" are in the no-joint-venture clause (10.2), which is unrelated. With no cap at all, both parties — including the Company — are exposed to unlimited liability, which fails both the preferred and fallback positions. We inserted a new Section 10.9 at the preferred position: a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and confirmation that the Company's payment obligations under Sections 3 and 4.2 are not capped damages. The fallback (plain twelve months' fees with indemnity/confidentiality/gross negligence/wilful misconduct carve-outs) remains available if HDI resists the USD 1,000,000 floor.

proposal.summary: Insert a mutual liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no limitation of liability, so we added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, together with a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. Consistent with our playbook, indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations are not treated as capped damages.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, (a) neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, and (b) each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000). "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to pay amounts due under Section 3 or Section 4.2 shall not be treated as damages subject to the foregoing cap.
